content: @copilotkit/vue is real and official (merged upstream June 2026) but young: official status table lists Vue as 'Supported — quickstart coming soon' (React/Next GA). Port author: 'still got some rough edges, but works so far'. Known bugs: #6104 attachments structuredClone; #6125 documents a Vue-only cloneForThread API and notes react-core docs mismatch. npm adoption minimal. Mitigation: pin exact versions, wrap all CopilotKit components in thin local wrapper components, keep renderers ported into slots, verify each feature in E2E before relying on it.
